name: dev
description: A dedicated software-dev project wired to the shared Gitea: the agent works your repo's fork via PRs, with its own inner Docker for test containers.
greeting:
Dev project — a yolo dev agent with its own inner Docker.

Your fork is cloned at /workspace/<repo> (origin = your fork, upstream = the
read-only GitHub mirror; work on agent/* branches, deliver via PRs). This
project holds no human credentials — the human fetches and reviews outside.

Get going:
  claude | pi           start the agent, whichever this project carries (sign
                        in first: `/login` for claude; `/login` inside pi with an
                        API key — OpenRouter or another provider, not the Claude
                        subscription — the project boots credential-less)
  rs-repo-watch         after claude's /login: watch Gitea issues/PRs and
                        drive claude automatically (blocks this terminal;
                        Ctrl+C to stop, or append & to background it; one
                        at a time)
  rs-wt                 every unit of work: one git worktree + agent/* branch
                        per task (new/list/done/reopen); the primary clone
                        stays on the base branch
  docker …              the inner Docker daemon is yours for test containers

More repos: research dev attach <project> --repo <name> (host).
